description: Surgical edits to the pristine Theater 1.10.0 main.js. Re-anchored from the 1.9.2 baseline (b202cd0 + fork mods identified during the 2026-10 re-baseline) onto the 1.10.0 minified output.

ops.note: Shared TextField: suppress TV-keyboard autocompletion/autocorrect (the VIDAA keyboard was injecting suggestion/mask content into URL and search fields).
ops.replace: var Xt=(0,r.vs)("<input type=text autocomplete=off autocorrect=off autocapitalize=off>");

ops.note: Shared TextField: VIDAA keyboard fix (fork mod from 1.9.2). The TV's virtual keyboard sets input.value directly without firing events, so Enter/blur/input are wired to the app's onSubmit/onChange and a 500ms poll mirrors value changes (cleared when the input detaches).
Nav: /discover/channel -> /discover/tv and focus matches the 'tv' catalog type too (fork mod from 1.9.2; core-web 0.64.x serves the TV channel catalog as type 'tv').
App root (Issue #34): destructure ctx.settings with {lazy:!0} so interfaceLanguage is a reactive getter even when ctx.settings starts as {} before the initial debounced core state update fires.
Spatial nav: the edge-distance switch had no breaks, so every direction fell through to the 'right' formula and up/down/left distances were wrong.

Spatial nav: candidates were sorted by distance and then re-sorted by alignment, so alignment alone decided and far-but-aligned items beat near ones (e.g. a dialog's Confirm button could never win). Rank by one combined score instead.

Spatial nav: skip hidden/detached focusables (zero-size layout reads as the page's top-left corner and steals moves). Only for measured items: the navbar area is registered with layoutUpdate:false and keeps a zero layout on purpose.

Spatial nav: layouts were only measured when a focusable was registered, so after animations, dialogs opening or scrolling, cached positions went stale and some buttons became unreachable. Re-measure on every move.
